Customer Success Co-ordinator

Birmingham

Full Time Permanent.

Salary up to £40,000 per annum, plus, company car allowance.

42.5 hours per week Monday – Friday

We are the largest provider of repairs and maintenance, and regeneration services across the UK. Mears provide tailored rapid-response and planned maintenance services through partnering arrangements with more than 70 local authorities, Arm’s Length Management Organisations and Housing Associations.

About The Role

We're looking for a full-time Customer Success Co-ordinator to support the delivery of our Birmingham contract, playing a key role in ensuring customers receive an exceptional service throughout their journey with us. Acting as a central point of contact for residents, colleagues and stakeholders, you'll help build positive relationships, resolve queries, provide timely updates and ensure a consistently high standard of customer care.

This is a varied and rewarding role where no two days are the same. You'll work closely with operational teams to coordinate customer communications, manage expectations and support the successful delivery of works, ensuring customers remain informed and engaged at every stage. Alongside delivering excellent service, you'll also help drive our social value commitments by supporting and promoting initiatives that make a positive impact within local communities, creating opportunities that improve lives and strengthen the areas in which we work.

Duties

To manage all customer feedback and insight on the contract, including customer complaint resolution, in line with the Group approach and policy
Accurately use business and/or client systems to log, update and process in a timely manner
To act as contract champion and coordinate all social value activities.
To successfully manage actions, through insight, to deliver contractual customer KPI’s
To represent Customer at the contract SMT and attend client core group meetings
Conduct contract review to ensure KPI’s are being met, compliance against agreed policies & procedures & support continuous improvement
To manage customer engagement through Your Voice and resident forums
To manage activities to embed Group approach to Red Thread
To manage effective communications in branch, promoting positive stories
To deliver MAPD training across the contract
To maintain strong relationships with the client, local community and related associations, governing bodies and third parties
To support all local bid and mobilisation opportunities
To deliver Group Customer induction to all colleagues on the contract
To support retention/achievement of accreditations and awards when asked
Ensure all customer related policy, process and procedures are fully embedded and adhered to across the contract
Attend all Customer Success team meetings and forums

Role Criteria

Previous experience in a customer service, customer liaison or resident-facing role.
Strong IT skills, with the ability to use Microsoft Office and internal systems effectively.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
A customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering high levels of service.
Full UK Driving Licence.
Ability to build and maintain positive working relationships with customers, colleagues and stakeholders.
Proven ability to manage challenging or complex situations in a professional and solutions-focused manner.
Strong influencing, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
Experience working within social housing, property services or a related environment would be advantageous.

Benefits We Can Offer You

Company Sick Pay
Employee can choose between 4% and 6% pension contribution which the company will match with Scottish Widows
Life Assurance (2x annual salary)
£4,000 annual car allowance or Company car
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
Family friendly policies including enhanced maternity (14 weeks full pay, 12 weeks half pay and 13 weeks statutory pay), paternity (2 weeks full pay) and adoption leave
Employee Assistance Programme - free confidential support and counselling available
Mears Rewards offering discounts and cashback at leading retailers including travel, household items and shopping
Annual Mears Fun Day - Our annual Fun Day is organised as a massive thank you from the Executive team for all the hard work!
Volunteering leave – up to two days per year to support community initiatives
Cycle to Work Scheme
Share save scheme
Recognition and long service awards
Buy up to 5 days holiday each year depending on length of service
Learning and development opportunities
Career progression opportunities across Mears Group
Occupational health support
Green car scheme with Tusker after successful probation period
Be part of an inclusive workplace with access to a range of colleague networks and support groups focused on diversity, wellbeing and career development. From Disability, Pride (LGBTQ+) and Ethnic Diversity networks to Women in Leadership, the Women Operative Support Group, Women's Health, Men's Mental Health and Armed Forces communities, these groups provide opportunities for support, connection and professional development across our diverse workforce.

All our roles require candidates to have the entitlement to work within the UK, Mears does not currently offer visa sponsorship.

To drive a Mears vehicle, you must be aged over 21 have held your licence over 3 months and have less than 9 points.

Candidates should be aware that all our roles are subject to relevant Background, Identity & Security checks before commencement of employment.

Apply below or to discuss your application further; contact:

Francesca Swan (francesca.swan@mearsgroup.co.uk)

If you need any help with your application process, we are here to support you. We will be accessible every step of the way.

We proudly support the Armed Forces Covenant and are honoured to have achieved the Gold Award in the Defence Employer Recognition Scheme (ERS) to coincide with this, we hold an Endorser Award for the Career Transition Partnership, recognising our commitment to veterans transitioning into civilian careers.

Aura - the global reference point for sustainable packaging

As part of the Sun Chemical group, Aura's mission is to revolutionise the packaging market and pioneer global solutions that protect both business and the planet. We combine expert consultancy, world-leading technology, and strategic insights to help organisations manage sustainability every day. Our Insights team empowers businesses to spot future opportunities early, embrace proactive planning, and leave risk behind.

As a Customer Success Associate
, you'll play an important role in supporting our Customer Success team and helping Aura's clients get the most value from our e-halo platform. You'll work closely with Customer Success Managers and the Account Director to monitor supplier progress, prepare reports, support client activity and ensure actions and priorities are clearly tracked.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is organised, analytical and customer-focused, with an interest in developing their career in customer success, client support or sustainability.

What You'll Deliver

Monitor supplier progress across Aura's internal dashboards, identifying milestones, actions, risks and exceptions.
Provide clear and timely updates to Customer Success Managers and the Account Director to support client priorities and supplier performance.
Prepare weekly, monthly and ad hoc reports covering supplier progress, outstanding actions, blockers and next steps.
Support the Customer Success team with meeting preparation, trackers, records and follow-up activities.
Respond to supplier emails where appropriate, using agreed guidance and escalation processes.
Attend internal and external meetings, capturing key updates and actions and supporting follow-up activity.
Monitor supplier queries and issues, ensuring information is shared with the right teams and escalated when required.
Work collaboratively with Customer Success, Supplier Success and wider Aura teams to keep supplier activity organised and progressing.
Maintain accurate supplier records, reports and supporting documentation in line with Aura processes

What We're Looking For

Experience in an administrative, customer support, supplier support, reporting or coordination role.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining attention to detail.
Confidence working with data, dashboards and trackers to monitor progress and identify anything that needs attention.
Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
A proactive approach to following up actions, asking questions and keeping colleagues and stakeholders informed.
Good attention to detail and confidence checking information for accuracy.
Ability to prioritise workload, manage deadlines and follow agreed processes.
Comfortable attending meetings, taking notes and following up on agreed actions.
A collaborative approach, with the ability to support colleagues and contribute to a high standard of service.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn about Aura's clients, suppliers, processes and technology.
Comfortable using Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams and PowerPoint, with an interest in using tools such as Copilot.

At Aura, you'll be part of a team shaping the future of packaging sustainability on a global scale. You'll collaborate with some of the world's most forward-thinking retailers and brands, work with cutting-edge technology, and develop your career in a supportive, collaborative environment.

You'll gain valuable experience working alongside Customer Success Managers, Account Directors and teams across Aura, developing your skills in client support, data analysis, reporting and relationship management.

Our technology, including e-halo, gives clients real-time visibility of packaging data, helping them manage compliance, identify risk, improve sustainability and drive positive commercial impact.

Every day, your work will contribute to meaningful, measurable change for businesses, people and the planet.

Employment Hero is on a mission to make employment easier and more valuable for everyone around the world. Our Employment Operating System brings hiring, HR, payroll and benefits into an all-in-one solution.

The EH Way

At Employment Hero, we’re proud of our unique DNA, which we call The EH Way.

We are Mission First - Our Mission determines what we work on, where we invest, and where we focus. Every decision runs through a single filter: does this accelerate our Mission?

We Live by Our Values - we role model our values at all times

This role

As our Senior Manager, Customer Success & Account Management, you’ll be working with our UK Managing Director, and will be instrumental in leading the commercial evolution of our UK Customer Success function. You will lead our regional team to protect and expand our customer portfolio while shifting our operational focus from reactive support to proactive, commercially-driven revenue growth.

Your key focus areas will be

Own the revenue trajectory of the UK book: You will carry a Net Revenue Retention (NRR) quota across the UK portfolio, accountable for both preventing churn and growing ARR through product adoption and expansion.
Turn adoption into advocacy: You will drive measurable product usage across the UK portfolio — supporting your team to move customers from go-live to active across the Employment Hero Platform — and convert the highest-performing accounts into referenceable advocates, case studies, and referral sources. Marketing & Product: You will need to align with our Marketing & Product teams both local & global to surface opportunities via Product Marketing and to provide insights to our Product teams that represent requests from our highest value customers.

Directly leading, coaching, and developing the UK CS (including Customer Success Managers, Partner Success Specialists, Hiring Support Specialists and Customer Growth consultants), establishing a high-performance, output-focused culture.
Designing, implementing, and executing proactive account development plans, QBR cadences, and robust risk-reporting playbooks that separate ‘Risk of Churn’ from ‘Actual Churn’.
Identifying and acting on commercial whitespace across our SME customer base, maximizing the monetization of new product features and modular updates.
Partnering with UK Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Product and Support teams to build a seamless customer journey and capture high-growth regional opportunities.
Working closely with UK Enablement to identify team product capability gaps and quickly execute training on rapid product updates.
Managing team performance objectively and independently to ensure absolute alignment with our high-performance culture and strategic direction.

Who you are

To thrive at Employment Hero, you’ll need to embody The EH Way - operating with focus, agility, and an obsession with impact. For this role, you’ll also bring

Proven people-leadership experience managing a Customer Success or Account Management team within B2B SaaS (HR, Payroll, recruitment Tech is an advantage)
Demonstrated track record running a team with quota-bearing expansion targets, owning commercial metrics such as NRR and NPS
Experience leading a team through strategic change management, transforming support or CX functions into commercial account management units.
Strong analytical capability and commercial acumen—comfortable using data and risk-reporting frameworks to understand portfolio health.
Fast learning agility with the ability to rapidly understand a complex, frequently updated SaaS product.
You will have great interpersonal skills as well as a strong bias towards excellent client service coupled with business outcomes.

What we can offer

At Employment Hero, we don’t just talk about a better way to work. We live it.

Joining Employment Hero Means You’ll

Competitive Compensation: A highly competitive base salary and a rewarding, performance-based commission structure tied to regional retention and expansion metrics.
Work in a remote-first environment, giving you the autonomy to do your best work while delivering meaningful outcomes.
Be trusted to own your work, make decisions, and have a real impact from day one.
Access cutting-edge AI tools and technology that help you move faster, think bigger, and amplify your expertise.
Surround yourself with ambitious, high-performing teammates who will challenge, support and inspire you to do the best work of your career.
Own ESOP (Employee Share Options) in one of the world’s fastest-growing technology companies, so you can share in the value you help create.
Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including generous parental leave, subsidised egg freezing, a home office allowance, and outstanding learning and development opportunities to support your growth.
Connect with colleagues from around the world at our Annual Global Gathering. We’ve celebrated together in Thailand, Vietnam, Bali and Dubai, and can’t wait to meet in the Gold Coast, Australia, for our upcoming gathering.

PSLD is responsible for the worldwide distribution of Cat aftermarket parts, integrated logistics, and global service to develop and support our global dealer network and customers.

The Logistics Planning Analyst
serves as a key contributor to facility logistics operations, warehouse planning, inventory management, logistics systems administration, performance reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role supports both daily operational execution and long-term strategic improvements by maintaining logistics master data, warehouse routings, location structures, operational reporting tools, audit programs, and material flow processes.

Additional Information

Location: Lebanon, Indiana
Required Travel: Up to 40% to the warehouse
US Work Authorization Sponsorship Offered: None
Relocation Assistance Offered: None

What You Will Do

Develop, maintain, and optimize warehouse routings, location structures, order control location (OCLs), pick paths, storage assignments, and material flow configurations.
Support warehouse planning activities including capacity analysis, storage optimization, inventory placement strategies, and material flow improvements.
Coordinate warehouse transitions, material relocations, inventory moves, and operational layout changes while minimizing disruption to daily operations.
Support integration of new part introductions, storage requirements, routing development, and warehouse readiness activities.
Analyze inventory and material movement trends to identify improvement opportunities related to storage utilization, replenishment strategies, inventory accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Maintain logistics and warehouse system data to ensure accuracy and efficient execution of operational processes.
Support operational systems and tools including warehouse management applications, reporting platforms, inventory systems, and logistics databases.
Investigate, analyze, and resolve system exceptions, transaction failures, data discrepancies, and process interruptions impacting operational performance.
Coordinate user access requests, permissions management, and system support activities for operational personnel.
Partner with Information Technology and business support teams to resolve system issues and implement process improvements.

Performance Analytics and Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance operational performance metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools.
Utilize Power BI, Excel, SharePoint, and other analytical tools to provide actionable operational insights.
Analyze trends related to inventory, productivity, material flow, quality, capacity, and service performance.
Support facility leadership through data-driven recommendations and performance reviews.
Ensure alignment between local operational reporting requirements and corporate performance measurement standards.
Lead or participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and operational efficiency.
Support Lean Manufacturing, HOPS, 5S, Stop-to-Fix, and Caterpillar Production System improvement activities.
Develop and maintain standard work, process documentation, workflows, and operating procedures.
Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to eliminate recurring operational issues.
Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve responsiveness, enhance visibility, and streamline logistics processes
Develop and maintain facility audit schedules and compliance tracking systems.
Coordinate operational audits and monitor completion of corrective actions.
Maintain documentation supporting operational standards, safety requirements, continuous improvement initiatives, and facility compliance programs.
Support EHS and operational leadership teams in tracking and reporting compliance-related activities.
Support facility and logistics projects involving warehouse optimization, inventory storage, material movement, system enhancements, and process improvements.
Coordinate project activities with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and execution.
Evaluate project risks, identify operational impacts, and recommend mitigation strategies.
Monitor project progress and communicate status updates to management and impacted business partners.

What You Have (Basic Qualifications)

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.
Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
Supply Chain Management - MFG: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling the logistical processes.
Logistics Management: Knowledge of logistics and management; ability to follow proper processes and run operations for effective and efficient movement of materials and finished products.

This is Caterpillar

The Senior Compliance Analyst works under the direction of the Chief Compliance Officer and serves as a key member of the Bank's Compliance Department. The role provides second-line review and challenge across the bank customer journey, including mobile application acquisition, account and loan servicing, electronic communications, and third-party supported processes.
The incumbent will perform independent compliance reviews, identify regulatory risks, support regulatory examinations, validate corrective actions, analyze compliance-related data, and provide compliance guidance to business units. Essential Duties and Responsibilities

CRA Compliance:

Maintain examination support and prepare concise reports for management and the designated board committee at the established cadence.
HMDA & Fair Lending Compliance:
Ensure compliance with HMDA Data requirements. Conduct Quarterly HMDA compliance reviews and transactional testing. Verify the accuracy and completeness of HMDA reportable data. Coordinate corrections with business units and validate remediation efforts. Support annual HMDA LAR validation and submission process. new_jobs.description:
Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. What You'll Shape

You'll work to drive our customer happiness to a new, all-time high by advising and guiding a wide variety of customers within the US market and maybe even beyond. With your help, they’ll launch Frontify successfully, adopt it widely, and continually drive business value from the platform. Over time, you’ll build up trustful, strategic relationships that contribute to our fast-growing business.

Guide new customers through onboarding and provide comprehensive training to ensure maximum value of our product.
Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key stakeholders, conducting regular check-ins to gather feedback and provide updates.

Oversee the renewal, upsell, and cross-sell process, collaborating with Account Managers as needed to address concerns and ensure customer retention.

Collaborate closely with sales, product, technical support, and marketing teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and spearhead interdepartmental initiatives.

You feel comfortable and excited to come to our New York office at least twice per week.
You have 6+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management in a fast-paced SaaS environment.
You're a natural at onboarding, proactively increasing product adoption, customer engagement, and satisfaction with your human and empathetic approach.
You've leveraged tools like Gong and Salesforce to track customer interactions, analyze insights, and drive data-informed decisions, while managing operational aspects of the customer lifecycle.

Your friends would describe you as authentic, intrinsically motivated, and responsible.

new_jobs.title: Senior Compliance Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Summary

The Senior Compliance Analyst works under the direction of the Chief Compliance Officer and serves as a key member of the Bank's Compliance Department. This position supports the Bank's risk-based Compliance Management System (CMS), with emphasis on consumer compliance, CRA, HMDA, and fair lending where applicable, monitoring and testing, regulatory change, complaint oversight, risk assessment, corrective action, and examination support. The role provides second-line review and challenge across the bank customer journey, including mobile application acquisition, account and loan servicing, electronic communications, and third-party supported processes.
The incumbent will perform independent compliance reviews, identify regulatory risks, support regulatory examinations, validate corrective actions, analyze compliance-related data, and provide compliance guidance to business units. The incumbent will assess proposed product and customer experience changes before launch and test whether implemented controls work as intended. This position requires strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, as well as the ability to exercise sound judgment in a highly regulated and fast-paced banking environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

CRA Compliance:
Support the CRA Officer in administering the CRA program under the framework applicable to the Bank and its approved strategic plan. Review the integrity of data used for applicable CRA reporting and performance analysis; evaluate relevant lending, community development loans, investments, and services; and analyze performance against documented goals and community credit needs. Maintain examination support and prepare concise reports for management and the designated board committee at the established cadence.
HMDA & Fair Lending Compliance:
Ensure compliance with HMDA Data requirements. Conduct Quarterly HMDA compliance reviews and transactional testing. Verify the accuracy and completeness of HMDA reportable data. Coordinate corrections with business units and validate remediation efforts. Support annual HMDA LAR validation and submission process. Analyze HMDA trends and identify potential Fair Lending risk or reporting concerns. Maintain supporting documentation and examination readiness. Perform Fair Lending risk assessments, monitoring, and data analysis. Assist in evaluating lending practices for compliance with the Fair Housing Act, ECOA, and Fair Lending requirements. Compliance Testing & Monitoring
Develop, implement, and execute compliance testing and monitoring activities aligned with the organization’s Compliance Testing & Monitoring Plan. Track and follow up on Corrective Action items arising from noted findings, and other relevant compliance-related reports. Coordinate with responsible managers to obtain status updates and supporting evidence and validate completed actions as assigned by the Chief Compliance Officer.

Regulatory Change Management:

Monitor regulatory developments issued by the OCC, CFPB, FDIC, Federal Reserve, FinCEN, and other applicable regulatory agencies. Conduct impact assessments for new and revised regulations. Assist business units with implementation of regulatory changes and best practices. Support policy, procedure, disclosure, and process updates resulting from regulatory developments. Maintain regulatory change management documentation and implementation tracking.

Consumer Complaint Oversight:

Review and analyze consumer compliance complaints received by the bank. Identify complaint trends, root causes, emerging risks, and potential unfair, deceptive, or acts or practices (UDAAP) concerns. Monitor corrective actions resulting from complaint-related issues. Prepare periodic complaint analysis and management reporting.

Regulatory Support:
Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and independent reviews by coordinating requests, preparing supporting documentation, tracking responses, and monitoring corrective action plans through resolution. Assist the Chief Compliance Officer in preparing reports, presentations, and compliance updates for Management Committees, the Compliance Committee, and Board of Directors, including drafting meeting minutes and related materials. Provide compliance guidance to business units regarding regulatory requirements, new products and services, policies, procedures, disclosures, and operational processes. Support compliance risk assessments, regulatory change management activities, and ongoing enhancement of the Bank's Compliance Management System (CMS).
Compliance Training Program:
Assist in administering the Bank's Compliance Training Program. Coordinate regulatory training assignments and completion tracking. Compliance training program for all staff, which consists of onboarding of new hires and assigned E-learning to all affected Bank management/staff.
Perform others related compliance projects assigned by the Chief Compliance Officer.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No Supervisory Responsibilities assigned.

Education, Skills & Experience

Bachelor degree in Business, Finance, or Accounting preferred.
At least seven years of banking experience, including at least three (3) to five (5) years of direct experience in Consumer Compliance, CRA, HMDA, Fair Lending, Compliance Monitoring, Audit, Risk Management, or a related regulatory function. Diverse experience across multiple lines of business and/or consumer products.
Demonstrated knowledge of consumer banking regulations and compliance management systems.
Experience conducting compliance reviews, testing, monitoring, risk assessments, or audit activities.
Experience supporting regulatory examinations, audits, and corrective action management.
Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. (Spanish and English)
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
Transactional testing and project management experience
Reporting preparation experience
Experience in areas including statistical analysis, database management, internal communications, auditing, risk assessments, and financial reporting preferred
Strong analytical and research skills and adept at examining and synthesizing data
Strong interpersonal skills, able to communicate professionally and interact with individuals across the organization
Strong computer technology skills and proficient with Microsoft applications
Able to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner
Able to conduct research projects with minimal supervision/guidance
Good organizational skills and detail-oriented
Able to work independently and on diversified projects while meeting deadlines
Work with integrity and ethically upholding organizational values

Mathematical Skills

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

Computer Skills

Ability to operate IBM compatible personal computers and terminals. Ability to use Microsoft Word (or similar word processing program) at: expert level_, intermediate level X, or beginner level. Ability to use Microsoft Excel (or similar spreadsheet program) at: expert level_, intermediate level

Reasoning Ability

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
